notes.title: Oh Oh Oh ! Small Fixes
notes.notes:
I made some quick adjustments of the game after some constructive comments !
Don't hesitate to communicate your thoughts via the comments/ review section.

* Reduced height of Toy shop for children's  
* Water bubble effect removed 
* Added more visibility to the snowball piles 
* Mine Cart seat position higher 
* Torch can't fall under the map 
* Snap Turn bigger angle 
* Text speed faster & stay longer 
* Added more understanding about the toys in the town

More update will come but I need to take care of the food ! :3 

I wish you all having a great Christmas Eve ! 
<3
